en.name: David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH)
en.roleOrg: Creator of Ruby on Rails & Omarchy
en.bio: David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH) is the creator of Ruby on Rails and Omarchy, a co-owner and co-founder of 37signals, and a best-selling author. He co-authored REWORK, REMOTE, It Doesn't Have to Be Crazy at Work, and Getting Real with Jason Fried. He also chairs the Rails Foundation and serves on Shopify's board of directors.

zh.name: David Heinemeier Hansson (DHH)
zh.roleOrg: Ruby on Rails 与 Omarchy 创建者
